vectors.description: Public derivative of the verified M02-101 payload: allow-listed fields only, 2-significant-digit quantisation, month-granular date, RAM class; commit and versions on the release allow-list, vendor and model on the coarse list. Only the row with a heat test can be carried.
q2 quantisation table (law: q2(q2(x)) == q2(x); values below 100 unchanged).
Results whose fileSha256 is not in the catalogue the device holds are dropped: nothing is left, so nothing is sent.
An engine commit and harness versions that are NOT on the release allow-list are emitted as `custom`.
Vendor and model that are not on the catalogue-backed coarse list map to `other`.
The public derivative of a FILE manifest (M02-110): the same allow-list, nothing that the file form dropped.

own body -> file body (LAB_SPEC 4.7): a new subject (the per-export key, ephemeral), no platformIds, no securityPatch, no seq, day-granular times, no battery level or screen state, no OS build or GPU driver; results recomputed from the file-form bench.
A run that crosses midnight: the start and the end truncate to their own days.
A desktop (no battery): the projection is the same and carries no battery level.
A partial run (charger removed): its finished tests project like a full one.
